args.text: CREATE TABLE P (ID LONG NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_P PRIMARY KEY, Code TEXT(10) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT UQ_P UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE Child (ID LONG NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_Child PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG NOT NULL CONSTRAINT FK_Child_P REFERENCES P(ID) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, Code TEXT(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'def' CONSTRAINT UQ_Child_Code UNIQUE, Score LONG NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, CONSTRAINT CK_Child_Score CHECK (Score >= 0 AND Score <= 100))
INSERT INTO Child (ID, PID, Code, Score) VALUES (2, 2, 'c2', 50)
INSERT INTO Child (ID, PID, Code, Score) VALUES (3, 1, 'badchk', -1)
INSERT INTO Child (ID, PID, Code, Score) VALUES (4, 1, 'def', 20)
INSERT INTO Child (ID, PID, Code, Score) VALUES (5, 99, 'badfk', 20)
UPDATE P SET ID = 10 WHERE ID = 1
SELECT ID, PID, Code, Score FROM Child ORDER BY ID
